package.name: hexa_pico_bridge
package.description: Gazebo-in-the-loop bridge for the Pico 2 W firmware (plan part 10, Tier 3). Compiles the target-agnostic firmware pipeline sources (pi-pico-firmware/src) directly and runs the real 50 Hz control tick against the simulated hexapod: subscribes /joy (the exact layout the firmware's bt_teleop emits), runs hexa::pipeline::Pipeline, and publishes the joint angles on /joint_group_position_controller/commands — so the firmware brain walks the Gazebo model with no hardware. Honors the repo's sim-first rule.
